title: I am currently in the process of finalizing my application via Uni-Assist for th
subject: Reference QA email case
turns: I am currently in the process of finalizing my application via Uni-Assist for the upcoming winter semester. However, I am facing some confusion regarding the document submission deadlines and whether hard copies need to be sent by post, or if digital uploads are sufficient. Additionally, could you please confirm whether the application portal requires certified translations of all academic transcripts at this stage, or only upon admission?
expected_answer_points: Correct, the only mistake is the deadline (June 30th, not July 15th - this is only on uniassist)
reference_answer:
Dear prospective applicant,

Thank you for your interest in studying at HTW Berlin and for reaching out with your questions regarding the application process.

Regarding your document submission, please note that **all documents must be uploaded digitally via the Uni-Assist platform.** There is no need to send hard copies by post. 

Concerning certified translations, **we require certified translations of all academic transcripts *at the time of application* through Uni-Assist.** Please ensure these are uploaded alongside your original transcripts. Uni-Assist will verify these documents as part of their initial assessment.

Please remember the application deadline for the winter semester is **July 15th**. We strongly advise you to upload all required documents, including certified translations, well in advance of this date to avoid any potential issues.

You can find detailed information on required documents and the application procedure on our website:

[https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/application-via-uni-assist/)

If you have further questions or encounter any difficulties during the application process, please don’t hesitate to contact us.

We wish you the best of luck with your application!
staff_comment: Correct, the only mistake is the deadline (June 30th, not July 15th - this is only on uniassist)

title: Hello, I am planning to apply for the Bachelor’s program in International Busine
subject: Reference QA email case
turns: Hello, I am planning to apply for the Bachelor’s program in International Business and I noticed on your website that the requirements include a C1 English certificate. I have already taken an English proficiency exam at my university in Brazil, where English was the primary medium of instruction. Would this be considered valid, or would I need to take an additional standardized test like IELTS or TOEFL? Also, could you let me know whether a motivation letter is mandatory for this program?
expected_answer_points: International Business is a course where they have lots of applicant, and C1 is required due to filtering. The requirements are therefore different for this one is differnet - a letter from the university is not enough - but the student needs to be from an English speaking country.
reference_answer:
Dear [Student Name],

Thank you for your interest in the Bachelor’s program in International Business at HTW Berlin.

Regarding your English proficiency, please note that a C1 certificate is generally required. However, we do consider proof of English proficiency gained through prior studies where English was the primary medium of instruction. You would need to submit documentation from your university in Brazil confirming this – ideally a transcript indicating the language of instruction and successful completion of courses taught in English. This will be reviewed to determine if it meets our requirements. 

Information on language requirements can be found here: Proof of English proficiency ([https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/](https://international-business.htw-berlin.de/)). Please ensure any supporting documents are submitted by the end of the application period.

Regarding your second question, a motivation letter *is* mandatory for the International Business program. Please ensure you include this as part of your application.

You can find more detailed information on the application procedure, required documents, and deadlines here:

*   Application periods
*   Admission requirements
*   Application via uni-assist ([https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/special-cases/](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/special-cases/))

Please also check anabin to confirm whether you have the necessary higher education entry qualification for Germany: Certificate assessment.

If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,

[HTW Berlin Student Services Staff]

title: To whom it may concern, I recently completed my Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality
subject: Reference QA email case
turns: To whom it may concern, I recently completed my Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management from a private university in the Philippines, and I’m very interested in transitioning into Business Analytics through one of your Master’s programs. I’d like to know whether my degree is recognized for admission in Germany, and if not, whether any preparatory programs or bridging options are available to help me meet the eligibility requirements.
expected_answer_points: It’s a tricky question and its so specific that it must be checked internally.
reference_answer:
Dear prospective applicant,

Thank you for your interest in pursuing a Master’s degree at HTW Berlin and for reaching out to us.

Regarding the recognition of your Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management for admission to our Master’s programs, particularly in Business Analytics, we recommend checking the “anabin” database. This is the official database used in Germany to assess international educational qualifications. It will provide information on whether your degree is directly recognized for university admission.

You can find the database here: [https://anabin.kmk.org/no_cache/filter/hochschulabschluesse.html](https://anabin.kmk.org/no_cache/filter/hochschulabschluesse.html)

If your degree is not directly recognized, or if you are unsure, you may need to demonstrate additional qualifications or complete preparatory studies. Depending on the assessment, this could involve completing a “Studienkolleg” (preparatory course) or taking specific bridging courses.

Please also review the general admission requirements for our Master’s programs here: [https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/applying-with-foreign-certificates/](https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/applications/applying-with-foreign-certificates/) 

Specifically, information about our Business Analytics program can be found here: [Insert link to Business Analytics Master's program if available, otherwise remove this line].

If you meet the basic requirements, the application periods are typically [Insert Application Deadlines - e.g., May 31st for the Winter Semester and November 15th for the Summer Semester]. Please check the website for the most up-to-date information as deadlines can change.

If you have further questions regarding specific eligibility requirements or bridging options, please don't hesitate to contact us again. title: I am a mexican architect interested in applying to the Construction and Real Est
subject: Reference QA email case
turns:
I am a mexican architect interested in applying to the
Construction and Real Estate Management Master program starting on winter semester 2026 .

I read that an IELTS Academic score of 7.0 is required for admission. Could you please
clarify whether this refers to the overall band score only, or if there is a minimum score
required in each individual component (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking)?
expected_answer_points:
Dear [Student],

Thank you for your interest in the Construction and Real Estate Management Master program at HTW Berlin. I'm happy to help clarify the IELTS Academic score requirement for admission.

To answer your question, our university requires an overall IELTS Academic score of 7.0 for admission to our master's programs. However, we also consider the minimum scores in each individual component (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking). Please note that you need to meet the minimum score requirements in all four components.

If you intend to apply for a degree programme conducted entirely in English, you are required to prove the existence of C1 level of English language proficiency with a recognised language test. Awarding of a place on the programme is dependent on this requirement. The minimum level shall be indicated via a recognized language certificate in the form of specific lanaguage test result.
English as a higher subject in your school leaving certificate is not accepted.
One of the certificates (level C1) mentioned in the following link must be attested:
https://www.htw-berlin.de/studium/bewerbung/bewerbung-ueber-uni-assist/englisch-sprachnachweis/
